initiatives.name: Portfolio Decarbonisation and Sustainability-Linked Financing
initiatives.summary: ICG has a portfolio coverage science-based target approved by SBTi requiring 100% of Relevant Investments to have validated science-based targets by 2030, with an interim target of 50% by 31 March 2026. The company reports it has exceeded this interim target, reaching approximately 80% coverage representing $10.7bn of invested capital.

evidence.title: Science-Based Targets for portfolio decarbonisation
evidence.summary: ICG has a portfolio coverage science-based target approved by SBTi requiring 100% of Relevant Investments to have validated science-based targets by 2030, with an interim target of 50% by 31 March 2026. The company reports it has exceeded this interim target, reaching approximately 80% coverage representing $10.7bn of invested capital.
evidence.quote: ICG has a portfolio coverage science-based target (SBT) approved and validated by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) which requires that: 100% of Relevant Investments (by invested capital) will have SBTi-validated science-based targets by 2030, with an interim target of 50% by 31 March 2026... Approximately 80% of Relevant Investments (by invested capital) have set SBTi-validated targets or submitted for validation – exceeding our interim target of 50% by 2026.

evidence.title: Sustainability-linked fund-level financing growth
evidence.summary: Since 2021 ICG has raised sustainability-linked fund-level financing with climate-related KPIs, totaling $3.2bn, linking its climate ambition to third-party financing arrangements.
evidence.quote: Since 2021, we have raised a total of $3.2bn sustainability-linked fund-level financing that has climate-related KPIs.

initiatives.name: KYC/Onboarding Process Automation
initiatives.summary: ICG enhanced KYC and onboarding processes, introduced new monitoring dashboards, and automated bespoke client reports, achieving a 40% reduction in quarterly processing time as part of scaling the operating platform.

evidence.title: KYC/onboarding process enhancements and reporting automation
evidence.summary: ICG enhanced KYC and onboarding processes, introduced new monitoring dashboards, and automated bespoke client reports, achieving a 40% reduction in quarterly processing time as part of scaling the operating platform.
evidence.quote: In parallel, a renewed focus on client reporting delivered material efficiency gains, including a 40% reduction in quarterly processing time and the automation of bespoke reports.

initiatives.name: Operating Hub Expansion in India and Warsaw
initiatives.summary: ICG continued investing in its operating hubs, expanding its outsourcing partnership in India and developing strategic in-house teams in Warsaw, resulting in approximately 40% of CBS team members now based in these two locations, delivering efficiency improvements in Finance and Operations.

evidence.title: Expansion of operating hubs in India and Warsaw
evidence.summary: ICG continued investing in its operating hubs, expanding its outsourcing partnership in India and developing strategic in-house teams in Warsaw, resulting in approximately 40% of CBS team members now based in these two locations, delivering efficiency improvements in Finance and Operations.
evidence.quote: The Group also continued to invest in its operating hubs during FY26, expanding its outsourcing partnership in India and further developing strategic in-house teams in Warsaw. As a result, approximately 40% of CBS team members are now based in these two locations.

initiatives.name: Real Assets Sustainability Frameworks
initiatives.summary: The proportion of AUM in real assets with specific sustainability frameworks targeting asset performance improvements has grown from 61% (FY24) to 65% (FY25) to 85% (FY26), alongside expansion of renewable energy generating capacity in European Infrastructure strategy.

evidence.title: Growth in infrastructure/real estate sustainability frameworks
evidence.summary: The proportion of AUM in real assets with specific sustainability frameworks targeting asset performance improvements has grown from 61% (FY24) to 65% (FY25) to 85% (FY26), alongside expansion of renewable energy generating capacity in European Infrastructure strategy.
evidence.quote: As at 31 March 2026, strategies with specific sustainability frameworks targeting improvements in the performance of assets represent account for 85% of AUM in real assets compared to 65% as at 31 March 2025, and 61% as at 31 March 2024.

initiatives.name: Board Composition Refresh
initiatives.summary: Robin Lawther joined the Board as NED on 1 November 2025, and Jonathon Bond was appointed as an Independent Non-Executive Director joining 1 April 2026, as part of Board succession planning ahead of retirements of longer-serving directors.

evidence.title: Retirement of long-serving NEDs Welton and Leith
evidence.summary: Stephen Welton and Rosemary Leith will retire from the Board at the summer 2026 AGM after nearly nine and six years of service respectively, as part of planned Board succession.
evidence.quote: Stephen Welton and Rosemary Leith will retire from the Board at this summer’s AGM after nearly nine and six years of service.

evidence.title: New Non-Executive Directors Robin Lawther and Jonathon Bond
evidence.summary: Robin Lawther joined the Board as NED on 1 November 2025, and Jonathon Bond was appointed as an Independent Non-Executive Director joining 1 April 2026, as part of Board succession planning ahead of retirements of longer-serving directors.
evidence.quote: We were delighted to welcome Robin Lawther as a NED on 1 November 2025. ... Subsequently, we were also pleased to announce the appointment of Jonathon Bond as a NED, joining the Board on 1 April 2026.

initiatives.name: Amundi Strategic Partnership
initiatives.summary: ICG entered a long-term strategic partnership with Amundi providing exclusive access to a leading global distribution network to access the private wealth market. Amundi also agreed a framework to acquire a non-dilutive equity stake in ICG, and nominated Vincent Mortier as a Non-Executive Director.

evidence.title: Strategic partnership with Amundi for wealth distribution
evidence.summary: ICG entered a long-term strategic partnership with Amundi providing exclusive access to a leading global distribution network to access the private wealth market. Amundi also agreed a framework to acquire a non-dilutive equity stake in ICG, and nominated Vincent Mortier as a Non-Executive Director.
evidence.quote: This year we were pleased to announce a long-term strategic partnership with Amundi, providing us with exclusive access to a leading global distribution network which we believe has the potential to deliver significant value in the coming years, without distracting us from growing our institutional business or changing our culture of being focused on investment returns.

evidence.title: Vincent Mortier (Amundi) appointed Non-Executive Director
evidence.summary: As part of the Amundi partnership, Amundi nominated their Chief Investment Officer, Vincent Mortier, to join ICG's Board as a Non-Executive Director, broadening the Board's asset management and finance expertise.
evidence.quote: As part of this partnership, Amundi has nominated their Chief Investment Officer, Vincent Mortier, as a Non-Executive Director.

initiatives.name: Operating Environment Rationalisation

evidence.title: Consolidation of third-party administrators and legacy systems
evidence.summary: ICG continued rationalising its operating environment through ongoing consolidation of third-party administrators, third-party accountants, and legacy systems to create a more efficient, integrated and scalable platform.
evidence.quote: Ongoing consolidation of third-party administrators, third-party accountants and legacy systems continued to rationalise the operating environment, contributing to a more efficient, integrated and scalable platform.

evidence.title: New Procurement function and supplier rationalisation
evidence.summary: ICG established a new Procurement function to drive value and continued consolidating third-party suppliers across the business to build consistency, review pricing/terms, and enhance supplier sustainability practices.
evidence.quote: Establishing a new Procurement function to help drive value for the business. ... Rationalisation of the number of key third-party suppliers across the business to help build consistency and deliver value

initiatives.name: Organic Expansion of Real Asset Capabilities
initiatives.summary: ICG diversified its product offering through organic expansion of real asset (infrastructure, real estate) capabilities rather than acquisition-driven growth, validated by strong fundraising including a record €3.15bn European Infrastructure close.

evidence.title: Organic expansion of real asset capabilities over M&A
evidence.summary: ICG diversified its product offering through organic expansion of real asset (infrastructure, real estate) capabilities rather than acquisition-driven growth, validated by strong fundraising including a record €3.15bn European Infrastructure close.
evidence.quote: We continued to diversify our product offering through the organic expansion of our real asset capabilities, rather than relying on acquisition-driven growth.

initiatives.name: GRC System Embedding and Scaling
initiatives.summary: The GRC system has been embedded into business-as-usual operations, providing a consistent and scalable platform for risk management activities, with second- and third-line processes operating within the Resolver environment as the Internal Control Framework matures.

evidence.title: Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) system embedded
evidence.summary: The GRC system has been embedded into business-as-usual operations, providing a consistent and scalable platform for risk management activities, with second- and third-line processes operating within the Resolver environment as the Internal Control Framework matures.
evidence.quote: The Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) system has now been embedded into business-as-usual operations, providing a consistent and scalable platform for risk management activities across the Group. Second- and third-line processes operate within the Resolver environment, with further processes scheduled to be integrated as the Internal Control Framework (ICF) continues to mature.

evidence.title: Salesforce CRM implementation for client engagement

evidence.quote: The implementation of Salesforce as the global client relationship management system further strengthened client engagement and internal connectivity, with additional functionality and enhancements planned for FY27.

initiatives.name: Climate Risk Assessment Platform Deployment
initiatives.summary: ICG introduced a new third-party platform to enhance climate risk assessment capabilities in both pre-investment assessment and post-investment monitoring, building on its bespoke materiality tool.

evidence.title: New third-party climate risk assessment platform
evidence.summary: ICG introduced a new third-party platform to enhance climate risk assessment capabilities in both pre-investment assessment and post-investment monitoring, building on its bespoke materiality tool.
evidence.quote: Building on the integration of ICG’s bespoke materiality tool which enables investment teams to focus on the most material sustainability factors for a given company, this year we have enhanced our climate risk assessment capabilities in both pre-investment assessment and post-investment monitoring, through the introduction of a new third-party platform.

evidence.summary: The Board held a strategy session identifying key themes including integrating AI appropriately into the Group's processes and practices as part of enhancing the firm's operating platform.
evidence.quote: A number of key themes were identified including the importance of maintaining the Group’s strong track record and investment quality, integrating AI appropriately into the Group’s processes and practices, and considering sectors which may provide investment opportunities for growth.
